items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...was there always a string band on Dave Ames there?

ctx.x: Nobody played in a string band. Nobody played in a string band. Nobody.

Nobody played in a string band. I was there always a string band there. Can you remember when it started or was there always a string band on Dave Ames there? What kind of string band did they have? Did they always have a string band there? string band band?

How far back, when you were a little boy, what kind of music did they have when you were a little boy, say seven or eight years old? Can you remember any kind of music you heard when you were, before you took up music? Mm-mm.
